lens: Simulated Ken Wong lens: mobile UI, first moments and wayfinding. Analytical exercise; no attribution of real opinions.

strengths.finding: The small white cube holds a clean focal point amid substantial negative space. The world feels intimate and quiet on a narrow screen.
Lugares communicates a useful next destination twice, with a strong white continuation button and comfortable touch targets. Progress and earned stars share a consistent gold language.
Faros turns navigation into a readable spatial metaphor: gold harbour, visible reach and edge arrows. The symbols explain more through placement than a dense HUD.
Explicit help is contextual: an active lesson supplies steps and a current hint, with a garden gesture replay. This is a useful route back from uncertainty.

issues.finding: The garden's actionable geometry and ambient marks are both extremely faint. In the supplied mobile frame the cube is clear, but the nearby rings and flower shapes offer little contrast hierarchy, so identifying the next useful interaction depends heavily on prior learning.
issues.remedy: Increase local contrast or give a restrained beat-linked response to the nearest relevant object. Keep distant ambience subdued and retain the intentional small cube.

issues.finding: Quiet journey screens suppress the contextual text surfaces, while the explicit game guide is inside the folded Más section. The start frame offers Pulso beside a crystal, but no visible movement instruction. This creates a costly recovery path if the gesture has been forgotten.
issues.remedy: When a round is active, expose its existing contextual guide directly in the first menu view, or retain one dismissible gesture cue until the first successful action. No extra permanent world control is needed.

issues.finding: Lugares lists eleven destinations in an independently scrolling region capped at 52vh. In the supplied frame only five completed rows and Jardín are visible, with no obvious indication that further destinations continue below.
issues.remedy: Add a subtle continuation cue or scroll-position indicator inside the destination list while retaining the visible next-step button.

limits: Blind alpha.200 review; no README, HANDOFF, PANEL, history or prior scores consulted.
Static mobile screenshots and source inspection only. No browser interaction, audio audition, full suites or human study.
Audio is null because no sound was observed. Sensation 7.5 is provisional and reflects visual atmosphere only.
Fixture frames are not a complete player journey. No claim that first-run onboarding is absent or that players actually fail these tasks.
No repository changes. The cube's small size is intentional and preserved.
